BiblicalUsage: Atharim was the place near which the Canaanite king of Arad heard that Israel was coming, and he fought against them and took some of them prisoner. It appears only here, at the edge of the wilderness road.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a place named once still matters, because Israel's road to the land ran past it, and God was with them on every mile.
